answers.ask: How massive is massive - a few dozen blocks, or a city you cannot cross on foot? It decides whether this is one map or several.
answers.answer: Make it one large continuous city map that takes a long time to cross on foot, with many dense blocks and varied building sizes.

answers.ask: Which disasters - earthquake, tornado, flood, meteor? Each one wants different terrain around the city.
answers.answer: Include earthquake, tornado, flood, and meteor disasters, all usable in the same city.

answers.ask: Is there scoring or an objective, or is destruction the whole point?
answers.answer: Destruction is the whole point; this should be a sandbox with no scoring or required objective.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D destruction sandbox map showing one massive, continuous city that takes a long time to cross on foot. Fill it with many dense city blocks and varied building sizes, arranged along a broad street grid with open corridors and districts that accommodate earthquake, tornado, flood, and meteor destruction.
agent_notes: Simulation / Physics Sim fits without any bending: breakable buildings whose collapse is the entertainment are physics-rig, and earthquake, tornado, flood and meteor are exactly the dynamic environmental events hazard-kill describes, all four layered over one shared space. Survival owns the word disaster in the index but the player here causes the disasters and nothing is survived, so I left it out of the genre list rather than naming it second. Shape is the preset's world-open in Simulation's own sense of one common world everyone operates in, and the answers settle the routing estimate outright - one large continuous city that takes a long time to cross on foot - so this stays P0 with no separate maps per district. Decided without a user: added settlement-density for the many dense blocks of varied building sizes, treated the flood as a disaster event rather than a standing water-body feature, kept the buildings as exteriors demolished from outside so no P3, and added no objective or scoring since the answers say destruction is the whole point.
